title: Pre-Board Walk
short_answer: Last cheap chance to catch missing backing, wrong ROs, and MEP not ready — before the first sheet makes mistakes permanent.
summary: The last cheap chance to catch missing backing, wrong ROs, and MEP that is not ready — before the first sheet makes every mistake permanent.
plain_words: Hanging over a problem is how you buy tear-out. Walk every wall. If insulation, boxes, backing, or rough openings are wrong, stop hang and fix or escalate. The hang checklist assumes this walk already happened.
when_to_use: Framing Status done; about to hang
Any doubt about backing, boxes, insulation, or ROs

steps.body: MEP: boxes set to plane; penetrations where they belong; nothing that will be buried without a plan.
Backing: casework, grab bars, TV mounts, door closers — present and marked (see Framing backing list).
Rough openings: door/window RO vs schedule. Wrong RO before hang is a phone call; after hang is carpentry + drywall.
Insulation / sound: first side done where required; perimeter seal plan on STC walls.
Rated / shaft: confirm assembly tag and photo plan for layers you will cover. No guessing height or liner sequence.
Stop criteria: missing backing on a known mount, live conflict on drawings, firestop not ready where you must leave access — write RFI or CO path, do not "work around quietly."

warnings.title: Hang over a known problem
warnings.body: Missing backing on a known mount, live drawing conflict, or firestop not ready — stop and escalate before board.

quality_checks.prompt: MEP/insulation ready where board will bury it

common_mistakes.title: Skip the walk
common_mistakes.wrong: Start hang because the truck is unloaded
common_mistakes.why: Tear-out after hang is the expensive path
